notes: AMOUNT FIELDS WERE BEING CRUSHED TOO NARROW TO READ. In the scenario event rows the columns were equal fractions (1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 2fr auto) shared between a month picker, an amount, a frequency dropdown, an end month and a note. A month input needs roughly 150px for 'December 2026' plus its calendar icon, so it took what it needed and the amount collapsed to around 40px: too narrow to count the zeroes while typing, and worse on a phone. FIXED IN THREE LAYERS. The scenario event row now uses minmax() per column instead of equal shares, so every field has a floor and only the surplus is shared. A global rule gives numeric inputs a 96px minimum and month and date inputs a 148px minimum, anywhere in the app, because a grid cell defaults to min-content and will otherwise crush whatever is inside it. And below 760px any field containing a number takes the full row rather than half of one shared with a date picker. The inline currency-prefix wrapper is explicitly excluded from the minimum so that it shrinks with its container rather than forcing horizontal overflow. VERIFIED: the mobile full-row rule resolves to 'grid-column: 1 / -1' at both 760px and 390px, and inputs compute at 15px. NOT VERIFIED: the actual rendered pixel widths. The scenario editor is a modal and would not paint in the headless harness, so every measurement came back as zero. The CSS is correct by inspection and the media query demonstrably applies, but the on-screen result is worth a look on a real phone before trusting it. Also in this build: 'Edit my inputs' renamed to 'Edit balances' (12 occurrences). Regression unchanged and passing: instrument cross-page mismatch zero, Projection-to-Dashboard zero, Decisions-to-chain zero, no page errors.
